title: ARK: Answer-Centric Retriever Tuning via KG-augmented Curriculum Learning
authors: Hang Ding; Jiawei Zhou; Haiyun Jiang
why_relevant: Proposes retriever fine-tuning with hard-negative mining to better distinguish answer-sufficient evidence from distractor chunks, tangentially related to noisy retrieval robustness.
why_not_or_caveat: Primary focus is improving retrieval accuracy via curriculum contrastive learning, not robustness, calibration, conflict, or adversarial settings.
